users/search 'ends-with' regex on phone_normalized lacks an index — fine at current scale but could become slow with millions of users. Consider a partial/sparse index on phone_normalized or storing the reversed phone for prefix search.
_mask_email uses '*'*max(2, len(local)-1) which masks 2-char locals as '*' followed by '**' (e.g., 'ab' -> 'a**@'); the leaked first char of a 2-char local is acceptable but worth a note.
